visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of a marble-patterned table overflowing with Korean brunch dishes, including soup, rice, and grilled meats. A person's hand briefly enters the frame. The background is a bright indoor restaurant setting with large windows. (2) The scene cuts to a tight close-up of a black stone pot filled with a white, bubbling soup garnished with green onions. Steam rises from the surface. (3) Raw thick-cut pork belly is shown being placed into bamboo troughs by hands wearing black gloves. The scene shifts to grilled pork belly being dipped into a red chili sauce and then coated in crunchy breadcrumbs. (4) A hand tears apart a soft, golden-brown mini loaf of bread, revealing its fluffy interior. A knife then spreads a thick layer of white cream or butter on a slice. (5) A close-up shows a piece of pork and rice being lifted from a bowl of clear broth. A small metal bowl of white rice is then inverted into the soup pot. (6) Various side dishes are presented, including halved soft-boiled eggs with bright orange yolks, fried fish cakes, and small bowls of pickled vegetables. (7) A stone pot of yellow, fluffy steamed egg (Gyeran-jjim) topped with melted cheese is shown. A spoon scoops into the mixture, revealing its soft, airy texture. (8) Pieces of Korean fried chicken covered in a red glaze and a mountain of shredded white cheese are displayed. A fork picks up a piece, stretching the cheese. (9) A decadent dessert toast topped with a scoop of pistachio ice cream and fresh strawberries is shown, followed by close-ups of two colorful drinks: a pink strawberry latte and a green tea with a thick milk cap. (10) The final shots show the modern, clean interior of the restaurant with brown leather chairs and white tables, followed by the blue exterior storefront with a large white umbrella.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo pop track with a synthesized drum beat begins. A male narrator introduces the restaurant in a friendly, energetic Mandarin tone. Speech is fast and clear. (2) As the visuals change to boiling soup, a crisp, layered bubbling sound effect is introduced over the music. The narrator's pitch rises with enthusiasm. (3) A distinct metallic clink of a fork hitting a tray and a wet, squelching sound of dipping meat are heard. The music remains steady. (4) The sound of a spoon scraping the bottom of a stone pot and the rustle of a bread being torn are synchronized with the visuals. The narration maintains a high arousal level. (5) A light pouring sound accompanies the rice being added to the soup. The background music maintains its energetic, positive major-key melody until the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Korean restaurant 'Duo Chu Dian' (多初點) in Kaohsiung by showcasing its variety of dishes, including unique fusion items like pistachio desserts and traditional pork soup rice.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video provides the full address and brand name of the restaurant, and specifically invites viewers to visit.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency cuts and highly saturated close-ups of food to maintain engagement. The combination of savory Korean staples and trendy desserts makes the content broadly appealing.
